newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real closes steady on dollar inflows.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real closes steady on dollar inflows.

text.p: Brazil's real closed steady at 1.0470 per greenback on dollar inflows in the commercial foreign exchange market on the last day of trade before the long Carnival weekend, dealers said.
Preliminary figures for commercial and financial foreign exchange contracts showed a Friday surplus of $150 million.
The local currency dropped earlier to 1.0479 reais but recovered.
In the interbank foreign exchange floating rate market, the real fell 0.09 percent to end at 1.0529 due to an increase in the demand of dollars, traders said.
In the illegal parallel market, the real rose 0.28 percent to close at 1.077.
The forex markets will stay closed until Wednesday midday due to the four-day Carnival holiday.
